Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE 
 t_home_area varchar2(5);
 t_home_phone varchar2(20); --(8);--Changed by Touqeer as on Dated: 01/16/2012
 t_bus_area varchar2(5);
 t_bus_phone varchar2(20); --(8);
 t_int_flag varchar2(1);
BEGIN
 SELECT h_area_code, decode(intl_addr_flag,'Y',intl_home_phone_no,h_phone_no), 
 d_area_code, decode(intl_addr_flag,'Y',intl_work_phone_no,d_phone_no),
 NVL(intl_addr_flag,'N') -- Added NVL condition on 06112012. Ashok; 
 INTO t_home_area, t_home_phone, t_bus_area, t_bus_phone,t_int_flag 
 FROM donor_addresses
 WHERE donor_id = :donors.donor_id 
 --AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND rownum = 1; 
 IF t_home_phone is not null THEN
 t_home_phone := substr(t_home_phone,1,3) || '-' || substr(t_home_phone,4);
 END IF;
 IF t_bus_phone is not null THEN
 t_bus_phone := substr(t_bus_phone,1,3) || '-' || substr(t_bus_phone,4);
 END IF;
 IF t_home_area is not null and t_int_flag <> 'Y' THEN
 :donors.home_phone := t_home_area || '-' || t_home_phone; 
 ELSE
 :donors.home_phone := t_home_phone;
 END IF; 
 IF t_bus_area is not null and t_int_flag <> 'Y' THEN
 :donors.office_phone := t_bus_area || '-' || t_bus_phone;
 ELSE
 :donors.office_phone := t_bus_phone;
 END IF; 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN 
 null;
END;

 WHEN others THEN

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SORT_LIST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE sort_list (p_what varchar2) IS
 szDirection varchar2(5) := 'ASC';
BEGIN
 go_block('donors');
 if :control_block.sort_direction is null then
 :control_block.sort_direction := 'UP';
 read_image_file('downarrow.bmp','BMP','control_block.left_ind');
 read_image_file('downarrow.bmp','BMP','control_block.right_ind');
 end if;

 if :control_block.sort_direction = 'UP' then
 :control_block.sort_direction := 'DOWN';
 szDirection := 'DESC';
 read_image_file('downarrow.bmp','BMP','control_block.left_ind');
 read_image_file('downarrow.bmp','BMP','control_block.right_ind');
 else
 :control_block.sort_direction := 'UP';
 szDirection := 'ASC';
 read_image_file('uparrow.bmp','BMP','control_block.left_ind');
 read_image_file('uparrow.bmp','BMP','control_block.right_ind');
 end if;


 set_block_property('donors', order_by, p_what || ' ' || szdirection);

 -- now set the visual attribute for the button pressed to 'highlight_sort' and for
 -- rest set the visual_attribute to 'lolight_sort'.
 set_item_property('control_block.pb_donor_id', visual_attribute, 'lolight_sort');
 set_item_property('control_block.pb_last_name', visual_attribute, 'lolight_sort');
 set_item_property('control_block.pb_first_name', visual_attribute, 'lolight_sort');

 if p_what = 'DONOR_ID' then
 set_item_property('control_block.PB_DONOR_ID', visual_attribute, 'highlight_sort');
 elsif p_what = 'LAST_NAME' then
 set_item_property('control_block.PB_LAST_NAME', visual_attribute, 'highlight_sort');
 elsif p_what = 'FIRST_NAME' then
 set_item_property('control_block.PB_FIRST_NAME', visual_attribute, 'highlight_sort');
 end if;
 begin
 :system.message_level := 5;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 end;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RETRIEVE_DATA IS
 temp_direction varchar2(3);
 temp_order_by varchar2(3);
BEGIN
 go_block('donors');
 IF get_block_property('donors',order_by) is null THEN
 set_block_property('donors',order_by,'LAST_NAME ASC');
 set_item_property('control_block.PB_LAST_NAME', visual_attribute, 'highlight_sort');
 :control_block.sort_direction := 'UP';
 read_image_file('uparrow.bmp','BMP','control_block.left_ind');
 read_image_file('uparrow.bmp','BMP','control_block.right_ind');
 ELSE
 temp_order_by := substr(get_block_property('donors',order_by),1,3);
 temp_direction := substr(get_block_property('donors',order_by),-3);
 IF nvl(temp_direction,'ESC') = 'ASC' THEN
 :control_block.sort_direction := 'UP';
 read_image_file('uparrow.bmp','BMP','control_block.left_ind');
 read_image_file('uparrow.bmp','BMP','control_block.right_ind');
 ELSE
 :control_block.sort_direction := 'DOWN';
 read_image_file('downarrow.bmp','BMP','control_block.left_ind');
 read_image_file('downarrow.bmp','BMP','control_block.right_ind');
 END IF;
 set_item_property('control_block.pb_donor_id', visual_attribute, 'lolight_sort');
 set_item_property('control_block.pb_last_name', visual_attribute, 'lolight_sort');
 set_item_property('control_block.pb_first_name', visual_attribute, 'lolight_sort');
 if temp_order_by = 'DON' then
 set_item_property('control_block.PB_DONOR_ID', visual_attribute, 'highlight_sort');
 elsif temp_order_by = 'LAS' then
 set_item_property('control_block.PB_LAST_NAME', visual_attribute, 'highlight_sort');
 elsif temp_order_by = 'FIR' then
 set_item_property('control_block.PB_FIRST_NAME', visual_attribute, 'highlight_sort');
 end if;
 END IF; 
 :system.message_level := '5' ;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := '0' ;
 first_record;
 IF :donors.donor_id is null THEN
 go_block('CONTROL_BLOCK');
 ELSE
 item_change('control_block.s_list_id','D');
 set_item_property('control_block.pb_retrieve', enabled, property_false);
 END IF;
END;

RecordGroup.Name: LIST_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select list_id, list_name from donor_list_header
where list_id like 'LIST%' and exists (SELECT 'x' from
donor_lists where list_id = donor_list_header.list_id and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id) 
and to_char(insert_date,'MM/DD/YYYY') >=
(select to_char((trunc(sysdate) - parameter_value),'MM/DD/YYYY') from valid_parameters
where parameter_code = 'LOV_LIMIT' and parameter_type = 'ALL')
and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
